d:
Rashtriy chikitsa aayog ne 2023 ke medikal shiksha mankon se jure niymon ko vapas le liya hai. is phaisle se medikal kolejon men pardarshita, niymon ke palan aur nigrani ko lekar saval uth rahe hain. kya yah kadam niymon ko saral banane ke lie hai ya niyamkiy dhilaee ki or ishara karta hai?
Thank you for watching our video!
